END_Hellrider_Cleric
The Hellrider Cleric is a summonable ally during ⁠Confront the Elder Brain, if ⁠Zevlor survives Act One and Act Two.

Involvement

The Hellrider Cleric is possibly an exile from  Elturel that was discarded by the city following their descent into Avernus, due to her tiefling heritage, and despite her service as a Hellrider.[1]

The Hellrider Cleric can be summoned with the  Gather Your Allies variant  Hellrider Platoon if ⁠Zevlor has been rescued throughout both Act One and Act Two, and joins the party as an ally in ⁠Gather Your Allies.
